config_entries.label: Address
config_entries.description: The I²C address of the sensor. Defaults to `0x06`. The chip can be programmed to the alternate address `0x46`.

config_entries.label: Z Pulse Width
config_entries.description: Width of the Z index pulse. One of `1lsb`, `2lsb`, `4lsb`, `8lsb`, `12lsb`, `16lsb`, `180deg`.

config_entries.label: Direction
config_entries.description: The rotation direction in which the angle increases. Follows the datasheet's `DIR` bit (`clockwise` writes `DIR = 1`). If your encoder counts the wrong way, flip this. Not written unless specified.

config_entries.label: Hysteresis
config_entries.description: Output hysteresis window in LSBs of the 12-bit output. One of `0` (off), `0.25`, `0.5`, `1`, `2`, `4`, `8`.

config_entries.label: Analog Start
config_entries.description: Start angle of the analog or PWM output range (12-bit, same units as **zero_offset**).

config_entries.label: Analog Stop
config_entries.description: Stop angle of the analog or PWM output range (12-bit, same units as **zero_offset**).

config_entries.label: Output Mode
config_entries.description: Selects the incremental output format on the shared output pins.

config_entries.label: Zero Offset
config_entries.description: The angle reported as `0`. Accepts a raw 12-bit count (`0`-`4095`), an angle (`45deg`, `90°`) or a percentage of a full turn (`12.5%`).
